description: This Java class 'ResizeContext' manages the state during resizing operations in Android UI design, including bounds calculations, snapping to wrap_content or match_parent, and attribute generation for layout parameters.

classes.name: ResizeContext
classes.description: Manages resizing state, bounds, and layout attribute calculations during UI component resize operations in Android Studio.

methods.name: ResizeContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing the resize context with area, layout, layout view, and node, and setting up snap bounds.

methods.name: initializeSnapBounds
methods.description: Calculates wrap and fill sizes, and adjusts fill bounds to differ from wrap bounds for user selection.

methods.name: isFill
methods.description: Checks if a given layout attribute value indicates a fill (match_parent).

methods.name: getWidthAttribute
methods.description: Returns the layout width attribute value based on snapping state or pixel conversion.

methods.name: getHeightAttribute
methods.description: Returns the layout height attribute value based on snapping state or pixel conversion.
